To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

schools can contribute to making Scotland a more inclusive society by promoting a sense of community, by providing opportunities for young people to develop their skills and by encouraging young people to participate in their communities.

schools can make a contribution to social inclusion, but that this will only be effective if it is embedded in a wider strategy for social inclusion that involves the whole of the education sector and the wider community.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how schools are responding to the social inclusion agenda and the impact that this agenda is having on schools.
the extent to which schools can contribute to social inclusion and the ways in which they do so.
the extent to which the Scottish education system can be a force for social inclusion.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the schools can make Scotland a more inclusive society.
schools are a major factor in creating a more inclusive society.
the Scottish education system is a good system, but it is not a perfect system.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Scottish Social Inclusion Network will: * Develop and implement a comprehensive and coherent national strategy on social inclusion.

we have been able to identify the issues and to make progress in tackling them, and we are now in a position to make a significant difference in the lives of people who are currently excluded or at risk of exclusion from society.

we want to see the creation of a Scotland where people can live in decent housing; where there is a job for everyone who wants to work; where people have the skills they need to get a job and keep it; where people are healthy and can enjoy a good quality of life; and where people have the chance to take an active part in the life of their communities.
The main takeaway from our work is that
schools are not just a part of social exclusion, but also have an important role to play in combating it.
schools can play a major role in making Scotland a more inclusive society.
schools can make a significant contribution towards the goal of social inclusion.
